errors.evidence: The x-axis range is described as 1 to 1000, but the data points extend beyond 1000 (labeled as 10^3 on the axis) and start before 10.
The description does not mention the range of the y-axis, which is from 60 to 80, or the specific tick marks on the x-axis (10^1, 10^2, 10^3).
The description completely omits the "IKE" data series, which is represented by a red line with upward triangle markers and is listed in the legend.
The description fails to mention the different marker styles (circles, triangles, diamonds, etc.) used to differentiate the data series, which are specified in the legend.
